app.js.instructions: Core frontend logic (map, filters, voting, markers). Flag correctness bugs, XSS via innerHTML, and Leaflet/marker regressions. This is a single large file without a module system or bundler - don't suggest splitting it into modules unless asked.

*.php.instructions: PHP backend endpoints (SQLite via PDO). Flag SQL injection, missing input validation, missing rate limiting, and unescaped output. All DB access should go through db.php's loocator_db()/loocator_rate_limit() helpers instead of opening a new connection.

index.html.instructions: Tailwind classes are compiled locally via `npm run build:css` into output.css (see tailwind.config.js) - never suggest re-adding the Tailwind CDN script. Flag missing dark: variants, missing md: responsive breakpoints on new UI, and render-blocking script/link tags that should be deferred.

rules.rule: Never reintroduce the Tailwind Play CDN (cdn.tailwindcss.com) - CSS is built locally and committed as output.css
All SQLite access must go through db.php's loocator_db() helper rather than opening a new PDO connection
State-changing endpoints (votes, counter hits) must call loocator_rate_limit() before writing

other.context: Loocator is a static Vanilla JS/HTML/CSS PWA (no bundler, no framework) that helps people find public/accessible toilets using OpenStreetMap data (Overpass, Nominatim, OSRM). The backend is plain PHP with a SQLite database (PDO), deployed as-is on a shared Apache host - there is no CI/build pipeline on deploy, so compiled assets like output.css are committed to the repo.
